PRIV-1.title: Private Word files are in the public Word-to-Table repo
PRIV-1.lead: R5.docx and 'R5 -Table15.docx' are tracked in the public repo since 9 Oct, and S1.2/S1.3 tests quote Native Word.docx text. Rights and publication are yours.

options.label: Make the repo private (suggested)
options.body: You switch Word-to-Table to private in GitHub Settings (OTM may not change settings). Nothing is public from then on; later scrubbing can follow calmly.

options.label: Scrub, then rewrite history
options.body: Remove the files and literals, then rewrite or delete public branches and history; force pushes are your call.

options.label: Leave as is
options.body: The files stay public; recorded as your override in CL #1.
